mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy invent a successful Operation whose (callerRole, opKind) pair is NOT in the permission matrix — for example, a Member successfully invoking PatchAnyTask. LeastPrivilege explicitly requires (callerRole -> opKind) in PermMatrix.Allowed for every successful op, so it must surface the violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.callerRole = Member and op.opKind = PatchAnyTask }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy create two distinct `Created` audit entries for the same task, which is exactly the situation AppendOnly (lone Created per task) is built to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.ofTask = ae2.ofTask and ae1.kind = Created and ae2.kind = Created }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy invent a successful PatchOwnTask/DeleteOwnTask whose target is NOT owned by the caller, which is the bug OwnershipBasedAccess is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBasedAccessViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.opKind = PatchOwnTask and op.target.owner != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy invent a successful Operation whose target Task lives in a different team than the caller's contextTeam — the canonical multi-tenant leak NoInformationLeakage is built to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeakViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.opKind = GetTaskById and some op.target and op.target.team != op.contextTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy create an AuditEntry whose recorded (actor, actorRole, inTeam) triple is NOT backed by any Membership row — i.e., misattribution. AttributionCorrectness requires a witnessing membership for every entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no m: Membership | m.user = ae.actor and m.team = ae.inTeam and m.mRole = ae.actorRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy invent a Task whose owner is NOT a member of the task's team, breaking the data-model.md guarantee that ownership is anchored in team_memberships.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipExclusivityViolation { some t: Task | no m: Membership | m.user = t.owner and m.team = t.team }
